[
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins for melanoma should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor and in the same operative setting whenever possible.",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and genitalia.",
  "The 7‑point score is driven by the presence of a blue‑whitish veil (2 points) and localized irregular pigmentation (1 point).",
  "The blue‑whitish veil criterion is a major criterion contributing 2 points to the score.",
  "The localized irregular pigmentation criterion is a minor criterion contributing 1 point to the score.",
  "The clinician should verify the presence of a blue‑whitish veil on the image.",
  "The clinician should verify the presence of localized irregular pigmentation on the image.",
  "The presence of these visual features supports an elevated 7‑point score.",
  "The guideline recommendations have a consensus rate of 100 % (21/21)."
]
